title: Use of Force in Self-Protection
key_points: Force is justified when the actor reasonably believes it is immediately necessary against unlawful force.
Deadly force only to prevent death, serious bodily injury, kidnapping, or sexual assault or robbery compelled by force or threat.
Must retreat if it can be done in complete safety, except in one's own dwelling (unless the initial aggressor).
Force may not be used to resist an arrest by a known officer, even if the arrest is unlawful.
